messages:
marta-fin: Quick heads up — ACME has a $120k prepaid committed contract and they applied a promotional credit mid-billing cycle (starts 2026-03-12). Invoice 86421 shows a $15k promo credit line. How should we treat the credit for March close? Do we defer it or apply immediately?

leo-ops: Do we have the PO/contract amendment timestamp? that matters for effective period.

anna-sales: Contract amendment signed 2026-03-10, promo effective 3/12 per the change order. Customer will still receive service through 2026-12-31.

marta-fin: thanks. so original prepay was for 2026 calendar year, $120k recognized monthly. promo reduces cash received on invoice but it's effectively a discount on the committed term. wondering if we should treat as deferred revenue reduction vs immediate contra-revenue.

devin-rev: GAAP-wise, an attributable upfront discount that affects consideration should be recognized over the performance period. so allocate the $15k across remaining term. in practice for month-end: reduce unearned revenue and amortize monthly.

marta-fin: ok can you propose the journal entry for March?

devin-rev: simplest approach (monthly amortization): assume remaining service months = 10 (Mar–Dec). monthly amort = 15000/10 = 1500. For March (pro rata since promo applied 3/12, include 20 days): but we usually do full-month for simplicity unless material. sample entries: 

```
Dr Unearned Revenue (liability) 15,000
  Cr Contract Liability - Promo (contra-liability) 15,000  <-- record initial allocation (internal tag)

Monthly amort (example):
Dr Contract Liability - Promo 1,500
  Cr Revenue 1,500
```

If we want to reduce carrying balance rather than contra-liability, you can directly reduce unearned revenue balance and then amortize. Either way, document the allocation note.

leo-ops: sounds right. for month-close we'll post a reversing schedule for the promo in the revenue schedule table and tag invoice 86421 with promo code ACME-MAR-PROMO. can the close bot run a manifest? @close-bot run revenue-schedule refresh for org/acme invoice/86421

close-bot: Revenue schedule refresh queued for invoice/86421. ETA ~10m. :hourglass:

anna-sales: finance — can we confirm tax impact? the customer was billed net of promo; tax was calculated on net amount on the invoice. if we allocate promo over time, tax team may need to file adjustments.

marta-fin: good catch. i'll loop in tax but for recognition we proceed with amortization. i'll create the journal and tag for review. can someone add the allocation note to the monthclose doc? :memo:

devin-rev: adding note now — will attach amortization schedule and example JE. final approval from finance lead required.

marta-fin: thanks team. will wait for close-bot completion and then post the JE for review. :white_check_mark:
